notes: REVIEWER DECISION: HelloAsso looks mid-rebrand. The ring is still helloasso.com's live favicon, but its site header now uses a black condensed 'HelloAsso' wordmark, and its App Store icon (updated 2026-10) and its dev portal's apple-touch icon are the stacked 'Hello / Asso' wordmark (green on white, or light on maroon). That stacked icon exists only as raster as far as I could reach (helloasso.com and its subdomains return 403 to every fetch). If the ring is judged retired, the verdict for the new icon is no-official-svg.
license: HelloAsso brand mark, used nominatively to identify the connected service; trademark rights remain with HelloAsso.
